items.q: What actually builds willpower according to Goggins and Huberman?
items.a: There is **no life hack**. Will is built by repeatedly doing what you **don't want to do**. Huberman maps this to the **anterior mid-cingulate cortex**: it **grows** when you lean into friction you hate and **shrinks** when you coast on things you enjoy.

items.q: Why doesn't an ice bath you love grow willpower?
items.a: *"Everything I do in life, it sucks."* An ice bath you love → **no aMCC growth**; cold water you **fear** → growth. Keep **friction dialed to 10 forever** — renew daily like sobriety, no victory lap.

items.q: How does Goggins' stick-not-carrot motivation work?
items.a: *"It's all stick. There's never been a carrot."* No imagining paramedic glory or book-launch rewards — maybe/maybe carrot at best. Before hard tests a back-of-brain voice says *"this ain't you, bro,"* and he still executes.

items.q: Why is he "haunted" rather than inspired by his past self?
items.a: Early **abuse, racism, obesity, lies-for-approval** created a character he is **haunted by**. Improvement isn't permanent — *"once it turns off, I go right back to the David Goggins that is"* (the **300 lb, illiterate** version).

items.q: How should you handle the multiple voices in your head?
items.a: External criticism is **"cap gun fire"**; internal dialogue is worse. There are **multiple voices** — some all wrong — but years of practice let you **ignore them and still execute**. Listen to **your journey**, not everyone else's noise.

items.q: Why was failing properly the first part of success?
items.a: Black kid, **300 lb**, can't swim → Navy SEAL looked insurmountable. He had to **learn to fail properly** without dwelling, or stay in the hole — *"didn't talk about winning for years."*

sections.title: ADHD study system and perishable skills

items.q: How does Goggins study medicine with ADHD?
items.a: Born with **ADD/ADHD**, bottom-of-barrel learner: he **rewrites the same page daily** until photographic memory; Jennifer quizzes him; drug names learned **syllable-by-syllable**. Multi-millionaire at **49** and still **4+ hours/day** review because retention isn't permanent.

items.q: Why must he keep going back to the suck?
items.a: Even SEALs don't want to return — Goggins **must**. *"I don't want to go back. I have to go back… that is exactly where all the knowledge of my life exists."* Skills and identity are **perishable**; the journey **doesn't get easier**, but you're **always found**.

items.q: What does Goggins refuse to sugar-coat about obesity and change?
items.a: He won't soft-pedal for **300+ lb** friends: maybe you **like the horror film you're living**. A **tiny internal flame** is required — he can't light it for you. Weight loss **sucks every day**. Real passion is **daily unseen reps**, not stage passion; tools like the **accountability mirror** and **cookie jar** help, but the lived process is barbaric.
